description: Draft an email in Gmail to anyone ('draft an email to jane@acme.com about X'). Nothing is sent. Chat shows the draft as a card with the recipients, subject and body, and Open in Gmail opens it as a Gmail draft, filled in, for the user to review and send. Works with or without a connected mailbox. Write a specific subject and a plain-text body in the user's voice: short paragraphs separated by a blank line, '- ' for a list, no markdown emphasis or headings. Use this whenever the user wants an email written to someone else; send_email remains only for mailing the user their own address.

account.description: Email address of the connected mailbox to create the draft in. Omit to use the first connected mailbox.

body.description: The plain-text body of the draft.

name: create_gmail_draft
title: Draft email
